<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA must cover TelNet one-to-many with Maple & Crown and GridLink one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also require a separate TelNet GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and a separate GridLink GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. Additionally, one consolidated NetCom application should address FiberNet, both one-to-many.

Please share the drafts as soon as they’re ready—I’m eager to review them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>

Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised ETA version removing the distinction between transactions on GridLink and transactions on TelNet. Since Maple & Crown is the sole party authorized to list services on GridLink, the special provisions we drafted for what was originally a "many-to-many" platform are unnecessary. However, we must create a distinct set of GTCs for deals that Maple & Crown executes on GridLink, as the services there differ from those covered by Maple & Crown’s standard GTCs.
